stem.text: A rubber cord hangs from a rigid support. A weight attached to its lower end is gradually increased from zero, and then gradually reduced to zero.

stem.alt: Rubber cord hanging from a rigid support with a weight attached to its lower end; labels rubber cord and weight.
Graph with vertical axis force and horizontal axis extension, origin 0, showing a closed loop between two curves labelled stretching and contraction, with arrows on the curves.

stem.text: The force–extension curve for contraction is below the force–extension curve for stretching.
What does the shaded area between the curves represent?

A.text: the elastic potential energy stored in the rubber cord

B.text: the thermal energy dissipated in the rubber cord

C.text: the work done on the rubber cord during stretching

D.text: the work done by the rubber cord during contraction
